pharmacological_action_required: DATO/INFERENZA: remove a measured percent of the isolated NMDAR EPSC and read burst incidence against percent removed. d-APV is the reference; the curve itself defines the burst-abolishing percent (the unknown x).
compound_or_probe_qualified_or_identity_: d-APV: used at 50 uM in the source paper (DATO, 34634460); mechanism as a competitive, surmountable antagonist is CARRIED, no source read in this package bears on it; subunit preference mild (carried compilation). Qualified for use as reference once x is measured; not qualified as a subunit probe.
source_of_action_and_selectivity_limits: DATO: bursts abolished and reversible at 50 uM (carried). IPOTESI: surmountability means occupancy falls as glutamate rises in a burst, so the percent removed must be measured at the time of the burst, not assumed from concentration.
functional_control: INFERENZA: Time-matched vehicle; d-APV washout; isolated NMDAR EPSC measured in separate slices or cells from those scored for bursts (carried design, M04).
mechanism_discriminating_control: INFERENZA: A second, pharmacologically different way of lowering total NMDAR current at the same measured percent (a pore blocker or a different competitive antagonist) giving the same burst curve; and the AMPA arm at matched charge (H_general_drive).
conditions_that_make_it_interpretable: INFERENZA: recording Mg2+, holding potential and K+ measured; percent removed measured for the same drug and concentration; d-APV range spans 0 to 100 percent removed so that x is bracketed.
outcome_strengthens: INFERENZA: a d-APV curve with a sharp threshold at a measured percent x (a NAM that stops at its own ceiling below x bounds the NAM arm rather than failing it, and is listed under outcome_unresolved).
outcome_weakens: INFERENZA: Burst abolition at a percent removed that no NAM can reach (above the NAM ceiling of D09) leaves total gain intact and makes the NAM comparison unreachable by dose; a burst that persists at near-complete d-APV removal says the burst is not NMDAR-limited at that percent.
outcome_unresolved: INFERENZA: Coincident NAM and d-APV curves over a range shorter than x: compatible with total gain and with a subunit-agnostic threshold; no discrimination. INFERENZA: a NAM that stops at its own ceiling below x is also what a GluN2A or NAM-insensitive-triheteromer pool would give, so it does not strengthen total gain over them.
resolvable_from_public_sources: DATO: No: no isolated NMDAR EPSC, Mg2+ or glycine datum exists for this preparation (DATO, brief).
needs_new_experiment: Yes: M-N1, M-N2, M-N7 in new_measurements.tsv.

pharmacological_action_required: INFERENZA: a GluN2B NAM at saturating exposure removes at most 0.88 x f(2B) + 0.32 x f(tri) of the current (D09); burst fall at a smaller percent removed than d-APV needs (curve left of the d-APV curve) would say GluN2B-containing receptors weigh more than their current share; a plateau means the NAM-sensitive pool is exhausted.
compound_or_probe_qualified_or_identity_: Ifenprodil: mechanism read in a primary source for the diheteromer and triheteromer maxima (24607230: 88 and 32 percent); abstract-level only for Williams. Ro 25-6981: primary full text NOT reached; abstract values only (9 nM vs 52 uM), maximum inhibition and conditions unread; its triheteromer behaviour is transferred from ifenprodil and CP-101,606 (INFERENZA). Radiprodil (carried, 40994429 Table 1): rat GluN1/GluN2B 82 vs rat triheteromer 45 percent (human GluN1/GluN2B 91). Identity of the best NAM: unresolved between ifenprodil (read, but alpha-1 and sigma actions carried unverified) and Ro 25-6981 (carried as more selective, primary unread).
source_of_action_and_selectivity_limits: DATO: IC50 spans 72-340 nM for ifenprodil on GluN2B across one primary source (Hansen) and one abstract (Williams, full text unread) (assay differences: -40 vs -70 mV, glycine); maxima incomplete: 88 percent on diheteromers, 32 percent on triheteromers, 50 percent with 300 nM Zn2+ (24607230). DATO: glycine reduces ifenprodil inhibition at NR1A/NR2B (abstract, 7901753). Limit: native composition of L2/3 pyramidal cells at P13-P17 in this preparation is unmeasured; the only native fraction reached is about 30 percent at P15 in visual cortex (D07; Table 2 of 26185009, about plus or minus 10 percentage points; different region, cell conditions and read-out; it is a bound from one other preparation, not the ceiling for the Wwox cells). INFERENZA: a left-shift on an evoked-EPSC axis may reflect synaptic versus extrasynaptic or burst-pool differences (the NAM and d-APV act on different parts of the glutamate transient), not composition alone.
functional_control: INFERENZA: NAM washout is slow for radiprodil (carried) and unmeasured for ifenprodil in slices; use time-matched vehicle and a pre-determined plateau; keep Zn2+ and pH recorded.
mechanism_discriminating_control: INFERENZA: (i) A second NAM at the same interface differs only in chemotype, so agreement removes an off-target explanation but not the diheteromer/triheteromer ambiguity; (ii) the pair NAM plus TCN-201 at measured co-agonist gives three equations for three shares (f2A, f2B, ftri) only if additivity, recombinant maxima, equal agonist occupancy and a measured co-agonist and Zn2+ level hold; the TCN-201 term depends on glycine (D04: 3 uM) and the system is near-collinear (determinant about 0.12, condition number about 32 on the recombinant maxima, so an error of 0.05 in a removed fraction moves a share by about 0.1 to 0.3), the maxima are low-glycine values and tonic Zn2+ moves the NAM coefficient from 0.32 to 0.50, so treat the solution as fragile (INFERENZA, D09 with D04).
conditions_that_make_it_interpretable: INFERENZA: percent of isolated NMDAR EPSC removed measured for the same concentration; Zn2+ context recorded (with and without a chelator); glycine/D-serine level fixed; NAM and d-APV compared at equal measured percent removed, not equal concentration. INFERENZA: glycine/D-serine level also fixed and measured for the NAM arm, because glycine reduces ifenprodil inhibition at NR1A/NR2B (abstract of 7901753).
outcome_strengthens: INFERENZA: A NAM curve left of the d-APV curve over its attainable range (up to its ceiling), with the EPSC fraction measured and the AMPA comparator right of it.
outcome_weakens: INFERENZA: A NAM curve coincident with the d-APV curve at equal percent removed (no composition weighting); or a burst unchanged up to the NAM ceiling of D09 (recombinant maxima; the native ceiling of the Wwox cells is unmeasured, D07 about 30 percent being one visual-cortex bound) while d-APV needs more, which bounds the comparison and cannot exclude GluN2B-containing receptors that are NAM-insensitive triheteromers.
outcome_unresolved: INFERENZA: A plateau below abolition: it cannot separate a GluN2A-diheteromer pool from an insensitive triheteromer pool without the TCN-201 arm (D04, D09).
resolvable_from_public_sources: DATO: Partly: dynamic range from recombinant data (read) and one native bound (D07); the L2/3 P13-P17 fraction in the Wwox slice is not in any source reached.

hyp_id: H_GluN2A (GluN2A-containing receptors carry the burst dependence)
pharmacological_action_required: INFERENZA: a GluN2A-preferring NAM lowers the isolated EPSC and the burst more at low than at high co-agonist (internal specificity control from the earlier reading of 22553026, carried); on triheteromers it removes up to 72 percent, so a large effect does not prove diheteromers.
compound_or_probe_qualified_or_identity_: TCN-201: identity qualified for GluN2A-containing receptors by Hansen (91 percent on diheteromers, 72 percent on triheteromers, none on GluN2B diheteromers) and by 22553026 (carried: glycine-dependent, solubility limit 18 uM). Not qualified for slice use: no slice co-agonist or tonic Zn2+ datum.
source_of_action_and_selectivity_limits: DATO (24607230): IC50 370 nM (diheteromer) versus 1350 nM (triheteromer); maxima 91 versus 72 percent; no effect on GluN2B diheteromers. Limit: potency set by glycine/D-serine occupancy (carried); Hansen's TCN-201 series used 3 uM glycine with 100 uM glutamate (Fig 2 legend), a low co-agonist level, so the 91 and 72 percent maxima do not transfer to a higher slice co-agonist level.
functional_control: INFERENZA: Glycine-alone control (changes bursts if the co-agonist state, not the receptor, drives NMDAR activity).
mechanism_discriminating_control: INFERENZA: Two measured co-agonist levels in separate slices; response abolished at the surmounting level.
conditions_that_make_it_interpretable: INFERENZA: slice co-agonist level measured before the arm is read; solubility ceiling (18 uM, carried) bounds the achievable shift.
outcome_strengthens: INFERENZA: Burst and delayed response fall at low but not at surmounting co-agonist, together with a small NAM fraction.
outcome_weakens: INFERENZA: No effect at either co-agonist level while the isolated EPSC is lowered, or a fall equal at both levels (no co-agonist-specific action).
outcome_unresolved: INFERENZA: A partial fall: shared between GluN2A diheteromers and triheteromers (maximum 72 percent) and between co-agonist state and subunit.
resolvable_from_public_sources: DATO: No: no slice co-agonist level in any source read.
needs_new_experiment: Yes: M-N4. Can be dropped if the question is only total gain versus NAM-sensitive current (Q4).

pharmacological_action_required: INFERENZA: an AMPA antagonist and d-APV, each titrated to the same measured fraction of evoked charge (and on a second metric), give coincident burst curves; AMPA block also removes the depolarisation that relieves Mg2+ block, so abolition alone is not informative.

Perampanel is the only AMPA compound whose mechanism was read earlier (carried, 25229608: noncompetitive, culture, slow kinetics); NBQX and GYKI 52466 are use-only or carried; no AMPA-antagonist mechanism paper was read in this package by instruction. Datum that would resolve it: a primary selectivity paper for the chosen compound plus a measured fast-EPSC block in these slices.
source_of_action_and_selectivity_limits: Carried (ampa_nmda_discrim_20261108 probes.tsv): perampanel left NMDA currents unchanged at 30 uM in culture; no slice datum.
functional_control: INFERENZA: Matched-effect, release-reducing receptor-agnostic control (carried design M08).
mechanism_discriminating_control: INFERENZA: Matched charge on two metrics; AMPA arm and NMDAR arm on the same x-axis.
conditions_that_make_it_interpretable: INFERENZA: block verified by a measured fast EPSC; kinetics (slow onset) respected; the NMDAR reference curve from M-N1 on the same slices.
outcome_strengthens: INFERENZA: AMPA curve coincident with the NMDAR curves at matched charge, with the NAM not left of them.
outcome_weakens: INFERENZA: A NAM or d-APV acting at a smaller percent of charge than the AMPA antagonist (receptor-type specificity beyond drive loss).
outcome_unresolved: INFERENZA: Different metrics giving different orderings (charge is dominated by the slow NMDAR component).
resolvable_from_public_sources: DATO: No (identity and slice block unmeasured).

pharmacological_action_required: IPOTESI: the NMDAR dependence is due to the slice's depolarised resting potential and Mg2+ relief, not to receptor composition; the drug curves shift together when Mg2+ or K+ is varied.
compound_or_probe_qualified_or_identity_: No compound: bath Mg2+ and K+ are the manipulation (not a drug); d-APV and the NAM read at two measured Mg2+ levels.
source_of_action_and_selectivity_limits: DATO: the paper does not state recording Mg2+; resting potential is more depolarised in the knockout (carried Table 1). The ifenprodil effect is sensitive to Zn2+ and glycine, so state-type variables also move the NAM ceiling (D03, D06).
functional_control: INFERENZA: Graded Mg2+ and K+ with the same drug exposure.
mechanism_discriminating_control: INFERENZA: Both curves (NAM and d-APV) shifting together with Mg2+ means the comparison reads state, not composition.
conditions_that_make_it_interpretable: INFERENZA: Mg2+, K+, Zn2+, glycine and temperature recorded as measured values, with blockers present.
outcome_strengthens: INFERENZA: NAM-versus-d-APV relation unchanged across Mg2+ and K+ levels.
outcome_weakens: INFERENZA: The NAM effect appears only at low Mg2+ or high K+.
outcome_unresolved: INFERENZA: Shifts of unequal size (partial state dependence).
